beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Schoology pre-grading now remembers completed Needs review decisions across restarts and retries a transient interruption once instead of repeatedly restarting the same work.
• Supported Google Docs directions can now provide grading context more reliably when an assignment has no separate rubric.

Fixes:
• Fixed resubmission R badges so they appear only for a real newer revision, keep the correct queue color, and survive course-card refreshes.
• Fixed background pre-grading repeatedly reconsidering completed work and incorrectly counting finished items against its work limit.
• A Schoology grade newer than the submitted file now clears its resubmission state without requiring an exception.
• When the PCA Extension cannot complete an upload, Buddy now explains how to recover instead of leaving the failure unexplained.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Missing Schoology work now offers a direct assignment link and a Reload action in the center of the viewer.
• Reload checks Schoology again and downloads newly submitted work automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed course-card clicks opening a different student's course or assignment. The selected student and course now stay together through grading.
• Fixed missing-assignment links sending signed-in teachers to the generic Schoology login page.
